title: Welsh Rarebit Frittata
description: A French twist on the classic Welsh dish, this frittata combines the rich flavors of rarebit with the simplicity of a French omelette.
instructions: Whisk eggs in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.
In a skillet, cook the hon over medium heat until crispy.
Add the mirin and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the whisked eggs and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 8-10 minutes.
Remove from the oven and stir in the rarebit sauce.
Return the skillet to the oven and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove from the oven and stir in the sour cream.
Slice into wedges and garnish with crispy onions and chopped parsley.
